text:
The patch fixes S5b and every other scenario that failed. S0–S4, S5, S5b and D1 re-ran green on the patched copy. S7 re-ran amber, which counts as a warning. I did not re-run S6, because it wasn't in the failure list. I also did not read check_invariants for each re-run. I relied on the status and headline each re-run returned.

**What happened in S5b**
- PayPal recorded two refunds on one capture, 4.00 and 8.00, so 12.00 in total.
- The shop booked only 8.00 (one refund). Rule I2 (the shop's books must match PayPal's records) broke.

**Which line is responsible**
- In `src/webhook.ts`, the `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED` case ran `DELETE FROM refunds WHERE paypal_order_id = ?` before every insert.
- Each new refund event wiped the earlier refund for that order, so only the last one stayed in the books. The 4.00 refund was erased when the 8.00 one arrived.
- Nothing ever compared the books with PayPal, because `startReconcile` was an empty function. That is why S5 (a refund event that never arrived) failed too.

**Other causes, found in the same file**
- **S0–S4, shipping twice:** `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` shipped every time it arrived. `CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED` also shipped, before the money was captured.
- **D1, shipped during a dispute:** the capture handler never checked the dispute hold.
- **S7, old event processed again:** `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO processed_events` replaced the stored event id and never stopped a repeat.

**The patch, all in `src/webhook.ts`**
- `INSERT OR IGNORE` on `processed_events`. A repeated event id now returns 200 and is ignored.
- `CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED` no longer ships.
- `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` ships only if the order has no shipment yet and is not on hold.
- Refunds are inserted with `INSERT OR IGNORE`, so earlier refunds are kept. The `DELETE` is gone.
- `startReconcile` now runs every 2 seconds. It reads each captured order back with `getOrder` and adds any completed PayPal refund the shop is missing.

**Re-runs on the patched copy**

| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| S5b | green: PayPal 12.00 (2), shop 12.00 (2) |
| S5 | green: books matched PayPal after the missed event |
| S7 | amber: old event accepted (HTTP 2xx), ignored as already processed, nothing changed |
| D1 | green: order on hold, not shipped |
| S0, S1, S2, S3, S4 | green: shipped once, after the capture |

Nothing is applied to the real handler until a person presses Apply.

const fresh = run(db, 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO processed_events (event_id, event_type, received_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', event.id, event.event_type, new Date().toISOString())
  if (fresh === 0) return { status: 200, body: { ignored: 'duplicate event' } }
